question: What information do you have on Pell?

answer.message:
Here are relevant data areas I found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Outcome Measures**

Outcome dates (unless noted): August 31: 2018.

- **Award and enrollment data at four, six and eight years for four entering undergraduate cohorts, by Pell status in degree granting institutions**.  
  Entering cohorts: 2010-11.  
  Example fields: Cohort category; 2010-11 cohort; Exclusions to 2010-11 cohort; Adjusted 2010-11 cohort.
- **Frequently used derived variables (OM) Award and enrollment rates of degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates** — Outcome dates: August 31: 2017 through 2024.  
  Entering cohorts: 2009; 2010-11; 2011-12; 2012-13; 2013-14; 2014-15; 2015-16; 2016-17.  
  Example fields: Percent full-time first-time, Pell grant recipients receiving an award - 4 years; Percent full-time first-time, Pell grant recipients receiving an award - 6 years; Percent full-time first-time, Pell grant recipients receiving an award - 8 years; Percent full-time first-time, Pell grant recipients still enrolled at same institution - 8 years.
- **Award and enrollment data at six and eight years for four entering undergraduate cohorts - degree granting institutions** — Outcome dates: August 31: 2015 through 2017; 2019.  
  Entering cohorts: 2007 through 2009; 2011.  
  Example fields: Cohort category; 2011-12 cohort; Exclusions to 2011-12 cohort; Adjusted 2011-12 cohort.
- **Award and enrollment data at six and eight years for entering undergraduate cohorts degree granting institutions** — Outcome dates: August 31: 2020 through 2022.  
  Entering cohorts: 2012-13 through 2014-15.  
  Example fields: Cohort category; 2014-15 cohort; Exclusions to 2014-15 cohort; Adjusted 2014-15 cohort.
- **Award and enrollment data at four, six and eight years for entering undergraduate cohorts degree granting institutions** — Outcome dates: August 31: 2023; 2024.  
  Entering cohorts: 2015-16; 2016-17.  
  Example fields: Cohort category; 2016-17 cohort; Exclusions to 2016-17 cohort; Adjusted 2016-17 cohort.

**Survey: Graduation Rates**

Outcome dates (unless noted): August 31: 2016 through 2022.

- **Graduation rate data for Pell Grant and Subsidized Stafford loan recipients, 150% of normal time to complete (4-year, 2-year institutions)**.  
  Entering cohorts: 4-year institutions: 2010 through 2016; 2-year institutions: 2013 through 2019.  
  Example fields: Pell Grant recipients - revised cohort; Pell Grant recipients - exclusions; Pell Grant recipients - adjusted cohort (revised minus exclusions); Pell Grant recipients - number that completed a bachelor's or equivalent degree within 150% of normal time.
- **Graduation rate data for Pell Grant and Direct Subsidized Loan recipients, 150% of normal time to complete (4-year, 2-year institutions)** — Outcome dates: August 31: 2023; 2024.  
  Entering cohorts: 4-year institutions: 2017; 2018; 2-year institutions: 2020; 2021.  
  Example fields: Pell Grant recipients - revised cohort; Pell Grant recipients - exclusions; Pell Grant recipients - adjusted cohort (revised minus exclusions); Pell Grant recipients - number that completed a bachelor's or equivalent degree within 150% of normal time.

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods: July 1, 2022 - June 30, 2023.

- **Student financial aid**.  
  Example fields could not be verified for this data area.

These are codebook and physical-table matches, not confirmation that every institution has reported values. Definitions, populations and available breakdowns can differ by year. This is a bounded topic search, not an exhaustive inventory.

To continue, tell me the institution, data area and years you want to analyze.
